author.bio_short: Miles Williams is the Broker/Owner of Real Property Management Southland, serving Long Beach and surrounding areas since 2014. He holds California DRE license #01968830 and specializes in residential property management for single-family and multi-family rental properties.
author.bio_long: Miles Williams founded Real Property Management Southland in 2014 while completing a Master's program at Cal State Long Beach — a testament to the drive that still defines how he runs the business today. Originally from the Bay Area, Miles built RPM Southland from the ground up and expanded the franchise territory in 2018, growing it into one of the most-reviewed property management companies in Long Beach. With over 11 years of local property management experience backed by the nationwide RPM franchise network, Miles and his team specialize in full-service residential management for single-family and multi-family properties throughout Long Beach, Downey, Lakewood, Torrance, and surrounding communities. His philosophy: consistency and the willingness to have tough conversations when they matter most. California Real Estate Broker, DRE #01968830.
